It is Meccan.

In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

{1–5} That is: Have you not seen [Muhammad] (ﷺ) what Allah did to the People of the Elephant? This shows His power, His great majesty, His mercy toward His servants, and the evidence for His oneness and for the truthfulness of His Messenger (ﷺ). They plotted against His Sacred House and intended to destroy it. They prepared for this, took elephants with them to demolish it, and came with a host that the Arabs could not withstand, from Abyssinia and Yemen. When they reached near Makkah, and the Arabs had no means of resisting them, and the people of Makkah had left the city out of fear [for their own sakes], Allah sent against them birds in flocks (ababil), meaning in successive groups. They carried stones of baked clay (sijjil), and pelted them with these stones. The birds pursued the stragglers and those in front alike, so they perished and were reduced to nothing, like a field of straw that has been eaten. Allah sufficed to repel their evil and turned their scheming back upon their own necks. Their story is well known and widely reported. That was the year in which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was born, so it became one of the preliminary signs (irhasat) of his mission and one of the proofs of his prophethood. All praise and thanks belong to Allah.
